description:
Check a token before buying, sending or accepting it, on Base, Ethereum or Solana: what it is, its USD price and liquidity, and plain warnings read from the chain (no pool, thin liquidity; on Base and Ethereum the contract's owner and whether it is upgradeable or can mint, pause, blacklist or set fees; on Solana an active mint or freeze authority).

$0.004 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

token.description: ERC-20 contract or SPL mint to check.

name: token_check
title: Token check
